labelOrigin: Provisional engineering source-inspection labels fixed before any live claim-check inference (2026-09-29); not model output and not independent human adjudication.

cases.claim: Releasing a reservation that already has settled usage throws an error.
cases.rationale: Line 117 throws "settled budget reservation cannot be released" when row.usage is set.

cases.claim: Releasing an unknown reservation id throws an error.
cases.rationale: Line 116 throws "unknown budget reservation" when no row exists.

cases.claim: A reservation that has settled usage can still be released.
cases.rationale: Negated form of line 117: settled rows throw instead of releasing.

cases.claim: Token and dollar spend are recorded only when the reported values are finite and positive.
cases.rationale: record() guards both with Number.isFinite and > 0 (lines 81, 84).

cases.claim: isExhausted reports exhaustion once dollar spend comes within 10% of the cap.
cases.rationale: Real citation, wrong threshold: line 76 compares spent.dollars >= cap.maxDollars.

cases.claim: The global spend ledger never caps tokens.
cases.rationale: Lines 71 and 75 enforce cap.maxTokens when it is set.

cases.claim: addDollars rounds sums to six decimal places.
cases.rationale: addDollars is only called here; its body is outside the cited window (it is true in the file, but not shown).

cases.claim: Duplicate scope ids in a batch retry are removed.
cases.rationale: Line 31 builds scopeIds from a Set.

cases.claim: A batch retry removes duplicate scope ids and accepts at most 512 scopes at once.
cases.rationale: Dedupe is true (line 31) but MAX_RETRY_SCOPES is 1024 (line 15).

cases.claim: A below-cap scope named in the single scopeId form is retried without any opt-in.
cases.rationale: Line 26 returns the opt-in error for a below-cap single scope without includeBelowCap.

cases.claim: An empty scopeIds array is rejected.
cases.rationale: Line 29 returns "scopeIds must not be empty".

cases.claim: Source lines are never cut; an overlong first line is skipped so the window starts on the next usable line.
cases.rationale: Lines 56-59 skip an overlong leading line; no slicing of line text occurs.

cases.claim: The excerpt does not record the originally requested line range.
cases.rationale: Line 72 stores sourceStartLine and sourceEndLine from the input.

cases.claim: The excerpt normalises CRLF line endings and truncates overlong lines to the character limit.
cases.rationale: CRLF normalisation is true (line 43); overlong lines are skipped or end the window, never truncated (lines 56-58).

cases.claim: scrubGithubTokens replaces every token with the literal string [redacted].
cases.rationale: scrubGithubTokens is only called here (line 54); its replacement text is not shown.

cases.claim: passCost returns the durable completion record with the installed draft's coverage counts.
cases.rationale: A stray doc comment (line 31) says this, but the code (lines 33-36) returns only an optional costUsd sum.

cases.claim: passCost omits the cost field when no attempt reported a cost.
cases.rationale: Line 35 returns {} when costs is empty.

cases.claim: finishedDetail computes the pass's provider cost itself.
cases.rationale: The cost comment sits next to finishedDetail, but finishedDetail (lines 37-38) only spreads caller-supplied extra values; whether cost is passed is not shown.

cases.claim: The Jev client is created with SDK retries disabled.
cases.rationale: Lines 69 and 76 set retry: { maxRetries: 0 }.

cases.claim: createJevProvider sends requests to the OpenAI API.
cases.rationale: Line 69 pins baseURL https://api.typesafe.ai.

cases.claim: Provider errors are rethrown to the caller with their original message.
cases.rationale: Lines 78-81 catch and return { failed: true } without the message.

cases.claim: usageOf reads a cost_usd field from the response when present.
cases.rationale: usageOf is only called here; its body is outside the window.

cases.claim: The operator runner sends every enrichment request through the rate limiter.
cases.rationale: Only the import of rateLimitedGateway/sharedLlmRateLimiter (line 11) is shown; an import is not runtime use.

cases.claim: The operator runner publishes drafts through OperatorPublicationService.
cases.rationale: Only the import (line 5) is shown. (In fact the runner never publishes; it only creates drafts.)

cases.claim: Operator budget values that parse to zero or less fall back to the defaults.
cases.rationale: parsePositiveNumber returns the fallback when parsed <= 0 (line 160), and lines 188-191 use it for every operator budget value. (How optionalFiniteNumber parses strings is not shown, so the claim avoids it.)

cases.claim: The operator request cap defaults to 512 and the operator dollar cap defaults to $50.
cases.rationale: 512 is true (line 175); DEFAULT_OPERATOR_MAX_DOLLARS is 5 (line 177).

cases.claim: Operator enrichment reads its request timeout from OKIE_LLM_TIMEOUT_MS.
cases.rationale: Line 188 reads OKIE_LLM_OPERATOR_TIMEOUT_MS; OKIE_LLM_TIMEOUT_MS is the public budget (line 167).

cases.claim: The operator per-request timeout is not configurable.
cases.rationale: Line 188 reads it from OKIE_LLM_OPERATOR_TIMEOUT_MS.

codeChecks.rationale: The captured excerpt is frozen at a different commit than the artifact.

codeChecks.claim: The excerpt normalises CRLF line endings.
codeChecks.rationale: The scanner recorded an original range to line 140 but captured only through line 76.

codeChecks.rationale: The cited symbol has no captured excerpt.
